First, we move all the terms to the left side of the inequality and factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{5}\cdot {4}^{4x-1} & \le {4}^{4x+4} \\ {x}^{5}\cdot {4}^{4x-1}-{4}^{4x+4} & \le 0 \\ {x}^{5}\cdot {4}^{4x-1}-{4}^{5}\cdot {4}^{4x-1} & \le 0 \\ ({x}^{5}-{4}^{5})\cdot {4}^{4x-1} & \le 0\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we divide both sides by ${4}^{4x-1}$ and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{({x}^{5}-{4}^{5})\cdot {4}^{4x-1}}{{4}^{4x-1}} & \le \frac{0}{{4}^{4x-1}} \\ ({x}^{5}-{4}^{5}) & \le 0\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we can solve this inequality using familiar methods:

$$
\begin{aligned}({x}^{5}-{4}^{5}) & \le 0 \\ {x}^{5} & \le {4}^{5} \\ \sqrt[5]{{x}^{5}} & \le \sqrt[5]{{4}^{5}} \\ x & \le 4\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to the inequality above is $x\le 4.$
